name: Rábacsécsény (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Rábacsécsény (a green and white shield with a yellow chevron, a fleur-de-lis and a sword, with a crown and green mantling) above the name RÁBACSÉCSÉNY in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Rábacsécsény arms with crown and mantling
